one_line: Pioneer of Muslim girls’ education and feminist writing in colonial Bengal.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to early-40s, medium height, softly sturdy build from years of teaching and household work.
appearance.face: Oval face with a calm brown complexion, gently arched brows, large thoughtful anime-style eyes with a steady gaze, a straight nose, and a small mouth that often holds a determined, slightly serious but kind expression; faint under-eye shadows hint at long nights of work.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair parted at the center, oiled and gathered back into a low bun that is mostly covered by her veil; only a smooth front line of hair shows beneath a modest white or pale-cream cotton or muslin sari pallu drawn over her head, with no ornate headpiece.
appearance.costume: She wears a simple, era-accurate Bengali Muslim sari ensemble: a soft white cotton or fine muslin sari with a narrow dark green woven border, worn in the early 20th-century Bengali style with the pallu covering her head and draped over both shoulders; beneath it a long-sleeved, high-necked light-cream blouse fully covering her torso, and a plain ankle-length petticoat; the sari is modestly loose yet neat, indicating middle-class respectability rather than luxury; she wears practical dark leather sandals, a slim brass wristwatch on her left wrist, a thin pair of plain gold bangles on her right wrist, and a tiny, almost understated gold nose pin on her left nostril to reflect Muslim Bengali customs of the period, with no excessive jewellery.
appearance.signature: A medium-sized worn brown leather school ledger and a stack of exercise books tied with a cloth band held in her left arm, and in her right hand a simple wooden chalk holder, symbolizing her Sakhawat Memorial Girls’ School work and daily teaching.

ref_desc: Begum Rokeya is a brown-skinned woman in her late 30s with an oval face, large thoughtful eyes, black hair in a low bun under a white muslin sari with a dark green border, cream long-sleeved blouse, simple gold bangles and nose pin, worn brown ledger and chalk holder, in white, green, cream, brown and gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Begum Rokeya Sakhawat Hussain in early 20th-century Bengal, showing her from head to toe in a modest, historically accurate outfit: she has a calm brown complexion, oval face, large thoughtful eyes, and black hair parted in the middle and pulled back into a low bun mostly hidden beneath a soft white cotton or muslin sari with a narrow dark green border; the sari is draped in the Bengali style with the pallu pulled over her head and across both shoulders, and she wears a light-cream long-sleeved, high-necked blouse and an ankle-length petticoat underneath, fully covering her torso and legs; her footwear is simple dark leather sandals, and her only jewellery is a tiny gold nose pin on her left nostril and a pair of thin plain gold bangles on one wrist, plus a slim brass wristwatch on the other, suggesting practicality over ornament; in one arm she carries a worn brown leather school ledger and a bundle of exercise books tied with cloth, while her other hand lightly holds a plain wooden chalk holder, symbolizing her daily teaching and school administration; keep the palette centered on white, dark green, cream, brown and small touches of gold, with a dignified, determined but gentle expression that conveys both resolve and compassion, and ensure the same hairstyle, sari drape, accessories and props are clearly visible from multiple angles for consistent redrawing.
